answer: One agent, one driving licence. To join, an agent shows a licence earned in person: a theory exam, then a road test on a real spiral ramp route, then a photo taken at the office. The card carries an ocean-blue hologram, and the holder reads a short sonnet aloud so the examiner can check the voice matches the face. A fake licence costs about 300 dollars in lessons, 40 dollars in test fees, and half a day at the office. One hundred fakes cost 34,000 dollars and fifty working days, all in person, with no way to copy one licence into a hundred agents.
